autoEscape.zh-CN: 是否自动转义 `searchWords` 中的正则特殊字符。关闭后 `searchWords` 按正则表达式匹配。
autoEscape.en-US: Whether to escape regular expression characters in `searchWords`. When off, each search word is matched as a regular expression.

component.zh-CN: 渲染高亮文本的标签名，如 `span`。
component.en-US: Tag name of the element that wraps highlighted text, such as `span`.

highlightClassName.zh-CN: 高亮标签的类名，与对象项的 `className` 一起添加到标签上。
highlightClassName.en-US: Class name of the highlight tags. It is added together with the `className` of an object item in `searchWords`.

highlightStyle.zh-CN: 高亮标签的内联样式，键使用驼峰写法（如 `borderRadius`），长度数值按 React 规则补 `px`。与对象项的 `style` 合并，对象项的同名属性优先。
highlightStyle.en-US: Inline style of the highlight tags. Keys are camelCase such as `borderRadius`, and numeric lengths get `px` as in React. Merged with the `style` of an object item in `searchWords`, where the item wins on conflicts.

searchWords.zh-CN: 需要高亮的文本，可以是字符串、字符串数组，或带 `text`、`className`、`style` 的对象数组。未设置时为空数组，不高亮任何文本。
searchWords.en-US: Text to highlight: a string, an array of strings, or an array of objects with `text`, `className` and `style`. Defaults to an empty array, which highlights nothing.
